sn48.56:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ: ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.
sn48.56:1.5: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu cittaṃ rakkhati āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu.
sn48.56:1.6: tasmiṃ cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu saddhindriyampi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
sn48.56:1.11: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa bhikkhuno pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitānīti.
